items.body: A callback with the wrong attempt can receive a successful reply. After answering a Complete callback for attempt 1, the model remains Started at attempt 1. A subsequent callback for attempt 2 produces `Poll(2)`, which emits a rejected self-loop. Runtime delivery replay accepts that emitted step without checking its outcome, then finds `RespondCompleted` enabled. Reproduced against the committed WASM guest: callbacks for attempts 1, 2 and 3 all returned Answer without a retry transition.
items.suggestion: Require successful delivery before publishing the reply, or validate the callback attempt against the current model attempt. Add a guest regression that accepts attempt 1, then refuses a mismatched callback while preserving state.
